title: Oral resveratrol in adults with knee osteoarthritis: A randomized placebo-controlled trial (ARTHROL)
why: Double-blind phase 3 RCT in PLOS Medicine reported to CONSORT: power calculation, central computer randomisation, flow diagram, CIs, harms table, NCT registration, data and code on request; near-complete.

title: Comparing Time Efficiency of Sprint vs. High-Intensity Interval Training in Reducing Abdominal Visceral Fat in Obese Young Women: A Randomized, Controlled Trial
why: Small 3-arm exercise RCT: says 'randomly assigned' with no sequence method, no concealment, no sample-size calculation, no registration, no data statement, p-values without CIs; flow, harms and declarations present.

title: Association of a healthy beverage score with total mortality in the adult population of Spain: A nationwide cohort study
why: STROBE-reported population cohort (ENRICA): sequential Cox models with named confounders, multiple imputation, flow diagram, HRs with CIs, prespecified analysis plan; only study-size rationale and registration are thin.

title: Dysregulated Nephrin in Diabetic Nephropathy of Type 2 Diabetes: A Cross Sectional Study
why: Small 2012 single-centre cross-sectional biomarker study: no dates, no size rationale, unadjusted correlations only, unexplained varying n, no CIs, no data statement; declarations, ethics and limitations present.

title: Sub-therapeutic vasopressin but not therapeutic vasopressin improves gastrointestinal microcirculation in septic rats: A randomized, placebo-controlled, blinded trial
why: ARRIVE-cited rat sepsis study: strain/sex/weight, a priori power analysis, blinded investigator, deaths reported, n=10 per group throughout, named tests; randomisation method not stated.

title: The Effects of Sleep Hypoxia on Coagulant Factors and Hepatic Inflammation in Emphysematous Rats
why: 2010 rat model study: animals 'separated into 5 groups' with no randomisation, blinding, size justification or exclusions, n per analysis only implied, no data statement; subjects, ethics and declarations given.

title: Endosomal chemokine receptor signalosomes regulate central mechanisms underlying cell migration
why: eLife cell-biology paper (HEK293, Jurkat) with MDAR checklist: catalogue numbers, STR + mycoplasma, N = independent experiments in every legend, explicit 'no blinding', MassIVE accession; some software unversioned, no limitations.

title: Phyllanthus spp. Induces Selective Growth Inhibition of PC-3 and MeWo Human Cancer Cells through Modulation of Cell Cycle and Induction of Apoptosis
why: 2010 in-vitro plant-extract study: ATCC numbers but kits/extracts without identifiers, no authentication, 'triplicates' of unclear kind, mean±SE with no statistical test, no data statement or limitations.

title: Prevalence and natural history of depression after stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
why: PRISMA 2020 meta-analysis in PLOS Medicine: PROSPERO-registered, 4 databases with dates and strategy, dual full-text screening, CASP risk of bias, random-effects synthesis, PRISMA flow; essentially complete.

title: Inclisiran: a new generation of lipid-lowering siRNA therapeutic
why: Narrative review of an siRNA drug's clinical path (stand-in for the CC BY-NC Onpattro review): clear aims, referenced, trial table, declarations; search lists databases/dates only, some loose reasoning, limitations are of the drug not the review.

title: SIR Simulation of COVID-19 Pandemic in Malaysia: Will the Vaccination Program be Effective?
why: Public-health epidemic model preprint (q-bio.PE cross-list): parameters listed, but data from an unnamed 'Government website', 11-day fit with no validation, no uncertainty, no baseline, no code, data, funding or COI statements.

title: COVISHIELD vaccine-induced thyroiditis: a case report
why: CARE-checklist case report (BMC): presentation, labs, imaging, treatment and follow-up described; 'no datasets' statement, no-funding, COI, consent and a limitations paragraph; few checks, all met.

title: Attention Is All You Need
licence: arXiv non-exclusive distribution licence 1.0 (not CC BY; Google grants reuse of tables/figures for scholarly work)
why: Machine-learning architecture paper (machine translation); no life-science or health content.

title: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger
licence: CC BY 4.0 (arXiv listing; the PRL version in the PDF states CC BY 3.0)
why: Astrophysics / general relativity detection paper (LIGO GW150914); no life-science or health content.
